model_annotation:
This figure contains two vertically stacked line plots, both sharing the same x-axis label "Steps" and y-axis label "Training Rewards," illustrating training reward trajectories for different model configurations on two difficulty levels.

The top plot is titled "Easy Training Set." The x-axis represents Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 500, with tick marks at 0, 50, 100, and 150 visible. The y-axis represents Training Rewards on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.05 to 0.4, with tick marks at 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. Two lines are shown. The teal/cyan line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts near approximately 0.05 at step 0, rises with fluctuations, reaching around 0.25–0.30 by step 100, and continues to increase gradually, ending near 0.35 at the final step. The red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," starts at a similar value near 0.05 at step 0, follows a generally increasing trajectory with noticeable fluctuations, and reaches approximately 0.40 by the end of the plotted range. Both lines exhibit considerable noise throughout.

The bottom plot is titled "Hard Training Set." The x-axis represents Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis represents Training Rewards on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.2, with tick marks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. Two lines are shown. The blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," remains near 0.0 from step 0 through approximately step 150, then begins a gradual and noisy increase, reaching approximately 0.20 by step 500. The brown/dark orange line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," remains essentially flat at approximately 0.0 across the entire range from step 0 to step 500, showing negligible change.
